findings.title: Retained local integration route skips new owner and authored-task bindings
findings.description: The new task_ready_binding is used for normal provider receipt attachment and retirement, but integrate still uses the old field comparison, omitting owner and generated authored branch identity. A READY with a different owner, or a consistently rehashed start/READY pair pointing at a same-HEAD alias whose branch is incompatible with its task id, is still allowed by integrate --check-only. In retirement_integration, the local integrate operation returns immediately after read_receipt; the read verifies schema/status/operation/repo but not worker or owner. An otherwise genuine local integrate receipt with only worker=8 or owner=different-owner is accepted by retire --check-only for worker9. This leaves the requested all-route owner/task receipt consistency unverified despite the normal provider correction.
findings.actual: All four negative probes return exit0/status allowed rather than a retained blocked receipt.
findings.impact: Managed integration/retirement gates accept contradictory author or integrator custody metadata. These probes do not demonstrate another branch being retired: current authored branch selection and exact Morgan retirement branch/owner/worktree checks continue to hold.
findings.regressionClassification: Remaining coverage gap in the retained local integrate path; those validation branches are unchanged by the 60c6->58c5 delta.
findings.recommendation: Use task_ready_binding(start, ready, ready.start_receipt, worker) in integrate without requiring current_task=True (the legitimate current checkout there is the target line). Before the local integrate receipt adapter returns, validate its worker and owner against the authored start/current policy along with the existing canonical repo, source/task/ready, exact review, ancestry and current-branch gates. Keep legacy incompatible receipts as evidence and block their cleanup qualification.
findings.validation: Require the four supplied negatives to produce exit2/status blocked, retaining normal provider and local integration positive paths and the temporary-retirement->fresh-dispatch sequence.
